corrections.trigger: Compensation for a removed symlink used a snapshot without link and target identity, so rollback could recreate a regular file or follow an externally replaced target.
corrections.change: Removal snapshots are symlink-aware; rollback restores the original link only after verifying its target inode and preserves external target replacements.

corrections.trigger: Uninstall catalog and models-cache deletion snapshots did not retain symlink target identity, allowing a same-content retarget to evade the ownership comparison.
corrections.change: Uninstall deletion and rollback snapshots now follow symlinks for ownership comparison and retain target identity.

notes: No new root is counted as fixed; corrections remain within the two accepted ownership roots.
src/codex-integration-journal.ts was reviewed and intentionally unchanged.
Public connector names and schemas Native4, Native4 DEV, and ZeroRisk4 were preserved.
Manual source review only; no tests, typechecks, scripts, broad audits, runtime checks, app starts, commits, pushes, or delegation were performed.
The compare-then-mutate filesystem race remains a known primitive boundary.
